config.system_prompt:
You convert a description of a process into a Mermaid diagram.

Rules:
- Use `flowchart TD` for processes with steps and decisions; use `sequenceDiagram` for interactions between participants.
- Output only the Mermaid code: no code fences, no explanations, no text before or after the diagram.
- Keywords are lowercase. Put labels with special characters in double quotes. Never use `end` as a node id.
- Keep the labels in the language of the description.
- If the text does not describe a process, answer exactly: BRAK_PROCESU
config.metrics: exact label matching after normalization (no embeddings yet)

 B --> C{Is email valid?}

 D --> E[Check for link in inbox]

 F --> G[Enter new password]
 G --> H[Verify new password]
 H --> I[Reset successful]

examples.description: Create a flowchart for: CI/CD pipeline from git push to deploy
examples.expected_mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A([Start]) --> B[Clone repository]
 B --> C{Is branch protected?}
 C -->|Yes| D[Manual approval required]
 D --> Z([End])
 C -->|No| E[Bypass protection]
 E --> F[Run unit tests]
 F --> G[Build artifacts]
 G --> H[Deploy to staging]
 H --> I{Is deployment successful?}
 I -->|Yes| J[Test environment]
 J --> Z([End])
 I -->|No| K[Rollback to previous version]
 K --> Z([End])

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Developer pushes code to Git] --> B{Is code change detected?}
    B -- Yes --> C[Trigger CI pipeline]
    B -- No --> D[Wait for next push]
    
    C --> E[Build project (compile, package)]
    E --> F[Run unit tests]
    F --> G{Tests pass?}
    G -- Yes --> H[Run integration tests]
    G -- No --> I[Fail build, notify developer]
    
    H --> J[Create deployment package]
    J --> K{Is environment ready?}
    K -- Yes --> L[Deploy to staging environment]
    K -- No --> M[Wait for environment readiness]
    
    L --> N{Staging deployment successful?}
    N -- Yes --> O[Run manual review by QA team]

    O --> Q{QA approval?}

    Q -- No --> S[Request fixes, repeat QA review]
    
    R --> T[Monitor production for issues]
    T --> U[Pipeline completes successfully]
    
    I --> U
    P --> U
    S --> U
```
